textbookBox.concept: Bharat has been known across the world as a land of wise and heroic people. Its rich and varied culture has attracted travellers since ancient times.

beats.en: Bharat has been known across the world as a land of wise and heroic people. Its rich and varied culture has attracted travellers since ancient times. The people here live in unison, which means together in harmony.

beats.en: In the story, a teacher asks students in a big hall if they are ready to meet friends from all over the country. The programme is called Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat.
